title: v1.0.93 — Astra Malayalam Platform & Performance Optimization
description: AcademicPulse v1.0.93 adds Astra Malayalam class platform support, optimizes subject lookup with O(1) caching, strengthens numerical/date safety, and boosts UI responsiveness.
features:
🎓 Astra Malayalam Platform
Updated class platform selection with Astra Malayalam across session logging, schedules, and attendance logs.

⚡ O(1) Performance Caching
Replaced repetitive array scans with optimized map lookups for faster rendering across large study logs and searches.

📄 Enhanced PDF Reports
Weekly, Monthly, and Day PDFs with comprehensive study type & platform breakdowns and full session logs.

🗓️ Calendar & Attendance Navigation
Smooth navigation across previous months with active day selection and monthly study hour summaries.

🛡️ Bug Fixes & Stability
Guarded mock score calculations against division-by-zero, hardened date parsing, and optimized UI animation layers.
